ideas.pitch: An intelligent e-waste collection bin built from discarded plastic drums and old stepper motors that automatically sorts discarded chargers, cables, and batteries by material type using simple computer vision.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Reduce the burden of waste management that threatens public health and the environment by designing innovative solutions using scrap materials.
ideas.title: E-Waste Smart Dustbin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the theme of turning discarded materials into practical, functional products with a live hardware demonstration that works on site.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost automated irrigation valve controller constructed entirely from old PVC pipes, discarded plastic bottles, and a repurposed water pump, controlled by a basic microcontroller.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Encourage innovative ideas for waste utilization, process modifications, and technical applications for real-life usability.
ideas.title: AgriScrap Drip Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high real-life usability and agricultural utility, which appeals directly to judges looking for practical societal impact.

ideas.pitch: A dual-axis solar tracking mount built out of discarded metal scraps, old bicycle gears, and salvaged DC motors to maximize small solar panel efficiency for rural charging stations.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Explore the hidden potential of discarded materials to work towards a more sustainable future and responsible waste management.
ideas.title: Scrap-Powered Solar Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines upcycling with green energy generation, offering a tangible, moving physical prototype that stands out during judging walks.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost household air filtration unit housed in discarded cardboard boxes and plastic packaging, utilizing layers of upcycled activated carbon from burnt agricultural waste.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Design and build innovative and practical solutions using scrap or recycled materials focusing on public health and environmental sustainability.
ideas.title: Upcycled Air Purifier Filter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses environmental pollution and public health using zero-cost materials, demonstrating strong social value and circular economy principles.

ideas.pitch: An IoT monitoring device built from discarded electronics housing to track gas pressure and temperature inside a small home organic waste bio-digester made from large plastic jars.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Innovative ideas for waste utilization and process modifications to convert waste into useful household products.
ideas.title: Plastic-Bottle Bio-Digester Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges waste management with IoT data logging, showing that physical scrap projects can also integrate modern software features.
